title: Renée Zellweger’s renovated 10-acre Topanga ranch returns to market for $7.995 million
summary_full: Renée Zellweger's stunning Topanga ranch, acquired in 2015 and beautifully renovated, has hit the market for nearly $8 million. Spanning almost 10 acres, this Spanish-style estate boasts breathtaking mountain views and exclusive hiking trails. Previously sold for $6.4 million in 2021, the property is perfect for those seeking tranquility in Southern California, featuring an infinity-edge pool and meticulously landscaped outdoor areas, appealing to buyers looking for space and luxury.
